units.source_text: 等道子从澡堂回来，朝仓没在房间里了。

en.t: By the time Michiko came back from the bathhouse, Asakura was no longer in the room.

units.source_text: 道子没瞧我一眼，摸了摸手提包，便打开拉门走到廊道上。

en.t: Without so much as glancing at me, Michiko touched her handbag, opened the sliding door, and went out into the corridor.

units.source_text: 她大概觉得在房间里化妆不好意思吧。

en.t: She probably felt embarrassed about putting on makeup in the room.
I did not look toward her.

units.source_text: 不大一会儿，天擦黑，电灯亮了。

en.t: Before long, dusk fell and the electric lights came on.

units.source_text: 我朝走廊望去，只见道子对着河滩，把脸贴在栏杆上，双手掩住眼睛。

en.t: When I looked toward the corridor, I saw Michiko facing the riverbank, her face pressed against the railing, both hands covering her eyes.
She had been crying in secret.
That feeling of hers moved me too.

units.source_text: 道子发现我看着她，当即站了起来，走进房间里。

en.t: When Michiko noticed that I was watching her, she immediately stood up and came back into the room.

units.source_text: 她那殷红的眼睑上，泛出了一丝微笑，仿佛要把她那虚弱的身体偎依过来似的。

en.t: A faint smile appeared on her crimson eyelids, as if her frail body were about to lean close to me.

units.source_text: 这种表情，我可以想象到的。

en.t: That was the kind of expression I could imagine.
